scope: Exploratory crosswalk; no runtime integration. Website labels are name correspondences except the site-exposed Tanneurs/Albert 1er serial binding. Detail URLs are extracted from website navigation.

daily_locations.retrieval: Web cached response retrieved 2026-10-31; cache says crawled five months ago, so freshness is not established.

method: Annual bicycle rows deduplicated by code_centrale, latest year. Point-to-LineString distance with local equirectangular projection (111195 m/degree and cosine latitude), rounded to 0.1 m. Candidates within 100 m or matching OSM ID. Strong means OSM match, compatible name, <=50 m and no identified conflict; manual conflict review overrides. Proximity is supporting evidence, not proof.
